newsitem.title: USA: Fed acts to ease Midwest financial woes due floods.
newsitem.headline: Fed acts to ease Midwest financial woes due floods.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said on Thursday it has asked banks in flood-ravaged Minnesota, North Dakota and South Dakota to be lenient toward borrowers who experience financial problems.

The U.S. central bank said "banks may find it appropriate to ease credit terms to help new borrowers restore their financial strength...and to restructure debt or extend repayment terms to existing borrowers."
The Fed said it also was considering waiving its requirement for appraisals for real-estate transactions since it is hard to do appraisals under flood conditions.
